SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF DEC-06-2017 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF DEC-07-2017 BY DONALD S. MITCHELL. PLAINTIFF WILMA DEUTSCH IS PRESENT VIA COURT CALL. DEFENDANT ADI SAMYOF IS PRESENT ON HIS OWN BEHALF. DEFENDANT SIMAYOF, INC. IS NOT PRESENT. NO PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE FOR YEDIDIA SIMAYOF, SARIT SIMAYOF NAMER OR ZACK NAMER. PLAINTIFF REQUESTS THAT ALL UNSERVED DEFENDANTS BE DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL; CLERK: J. MURPHY; NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-06-2017 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF DEUTSCH, WILMA IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT SIMAYOF, INC. SAMYOF, ADI AT PLAINTIFF'S REQUEST, PLAINTIFF'S CLAIMS AGAINST YEDIDIA SIMAYOF, SARIT SIMAYOF NAMER AND ZACK NAMER ARE DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE. DEFENDANT ADI SAMYOF SHALL PAY PLAINTIFF NOTHING (0) AS THE EVIDENCE DID NOT SUPPORT THAT DEFENDANT ADI SAMYOF WAS A CAUSE OF DAMAGE, LOSS OR HARM TO PLAINTIFF. PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM AGAINST SIMAYOF, INC. IS DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE AS NO PROPER SERVICE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
REMARK: RETURNED MAIL: NOTICE OF ENTRY OF JUDGMENT MAILED TO YEDIDIA SAMYOF ON 12/07/17. PER U.S. POSTAL SERVICE, "RETURN TO SENDER - ATTEMPTED - NOT KNOWN - UNABLE TO FORWARD."
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED MAR-01-2018 ORDERED DESTROYED
